sources.title: Facing OpenAI and Anthropic, Google Slashes AI Model Prices

checks.explanation: The predicted 5-year window (through roughly 2031) has barely begun.

Tiger Global's own strategic reversal confirms this: after its 2021-2022 mega-fund, all-stages approach underperformed, the firm downsized dramatically (from a $12.7B fund to a $2.2B fund) and returned to smaller, higher-conviction bets, exactly the pendulum swing predicted.

sources.title: Tiger Global Returns to Roots With Smaller $2.2 Billion VC Goal
